limitations: No active OR turns occurred in any target-recovery comparison.
Grouped capability validation contained two active OR turns, one hard; none distinguished the guard from both controls.
Two body-versus-component ranking assertions and three missing-comparator assertions failed in all validation controls.
All registered regression/resource gates passed; this is not evidence of population equivalence or first-place novelty.
Selected validation p95 was below one second, but parse validation had a 1.189-second maximum turn; serial timing differences are not causal speedups.
The real-catalog replay did not exhibit a grouped-guard benefit; the rank-changing witness uses an explicitly invented catalog.
Offline inference was verified after installation; air-gapped dependency installation and organizer hardware remain unverified.
